stories.title: A Baptist Brought Jesus to Burma. His Spiritual Descendants Bought His Birthplace.
stories.summary: Burmese Christians in Boston have long made pilgrimages to the Malden, Massachusetts, birthplace of Adoniram Judson, the first Baptist missionary to Burma. Now, his spiritual descendants have bought the historic home to preserve his legacy.
stories.extended_summary: For years, Burmese Christians in Boston would drive to a white colonial house in Malden, snap a photo in the yard, and leave. The house at 145 Main Street is the birthplace of Adoniram Judson, the 19th-century Baptist missionary who brought Christianity to Burma. But the building had been in private hands since 1979, its commemorative plaque removed. Now, Judson's spiritual descendants — Burmese pastors and diaspora Christians — have purchased the property, reclaiming a piece of their shared history and ensuring future generations can walk where their faith's pioneer once lived.
